title: Every graph is a list of solutions

lines.text: Is the point (4, 1) on the line $2x - 3y = 5$? ​ ​ ​ ​
lines.say: Is the point four, one, on the line 2x minus 3y equals five?

lines.text: {test} Keep only the ones that make it {true} *true.*

lines.say: Plug in, two times four, minus three times one.
That's five. It's on the list.
Now a second line, x plus y equals five.

lines.text: On the line means *true.* {solved} On both means *solved.*
